text:
anya: Heads-up — seeing a sharp p99/throughput regression out of sg-1 starting ~08:12 UTC. p50 steady, p95 ~1.2x, p99 ~5x, throughput down ~30%. kernel-selector fallback rate jumped to ~45%. kvcache prefix-hit went from 92% -> 61%. @mike can you take a look? :eyes:

infra-bot: Alert: region=sg-1 latency_p99 > 450ms for 5m. affected_service=runtime-serving

mike: On it. Can you paste the kernel_selector counters + latest batching histogram and an example request profile?

anya: Paste below — trimmed for thread:
```
kernel_selector: {
  fast-kernel-v1: 5800
  slow-kernel-v2: 4200
  fallback_reason: [kv_eviction=2700, kernel_mismatch=1100, short_seq_penalty=400]
}
batching.window_ms: 2 -> observed 8ms tail under load
kvcache: prefix_hits=61% prefix_misses=39% evictions_per_min=720
net.tcp_retransmits: 0.8% -> 4.1%
```
Also attached flamegraph link (internal): https://console.redwood/profiles/1900456789/sg1-flame

ravi: retransmits + kvcache miss spike -> suspicious of network path/peering causing higher RTT & host-level scheduling jitter, which would increase batch windows and cause kernel heuristics to re-evaluate. Can we tcpdump on one host and check BGP/peer status?

suzanne: FYI we rolled out a kernel-selector heuristic tweak to sg-1 yesterday (commit: 5a3b2f7) that penalizes kernels for short-sequence workloads to avoid cold-kv regression. Might be interacting with the increased batching window. Rolling back that heuristic on a host could be a quick test.

mike: Agreed. Quick experiment plan:
1) pin kernel to fast-kernel-v1 on 3 canary pods
2) bump kvcache size by +20% for those pods (reduce evictions)
3) capture tcpdump for 2 minutes at 10000 packets: sudo tcpdump -c 10000 -w /tmp/sg1-issue.pcap host X.X.X.X
4) monitor p99 + retransmits

anya: Doing step 1+2 on canary host sg1-canary-03 now. Command to pin kernel (runtime admin):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood/svc/sg1/canary/override \
  -d '{"kernel_selector_force":"fast-kernel-v1","kvcache_size_delta_pct":20}'
```

prod-oncall: Noted, running tcpdump and perf record on the canary. Will post results in 2-3 mins.

mike: If p99 drops on canary -> this looks like a kernel-selection regression interacting with kvcache/more jitter. If not, we'll look at ISP peering.

(2m later)

prod-oncall: Canary results: p99 dropped from ~520ms -> ~110ms on pinned host, throughput held. tcpdump shows a slight increase in retransmits pre-change but nothing huge during test. perf shows reduced time in kernel-selection decision path.

ravi: That suggests the heuristic roll (5a3b2f7) is misclassifying short-seq hot paths under slightly increased batching jitter and forcing slow-kernel. We'll roll a targeted rollback to the heuristic on sg-1 and sg-2 hosts and keep kvcache increase until we confirm.

suzanne: Opening rollback PR and a perf-regression ticket: https://issues.redwood/INC-4271 commit_revert=5a3b2f7. Also adding a unit test to simulate jittered batch windows + short sequences.

mike: After rollback on 8 hosts, p99 back to baseline across region, monitoring. Follow-ups: root cause RCA will include:
- interaction between kernel-selector scoring and batching-window tail behavior
- kvcache eviction sensitivity to throughput shifts
- add e2e test that replays observed tcp jitter + request patterns

anya: Patching rollout plan: rollback canary -> monitor 30m -> gradual rollout. Notifying support to inform customers if they saw degraded performance.

infra-bot: Incident INC-4271 created: sg-1 latency regression. Severity: Sev2. Owner: suzanne.

mike: Nice quick debug team. Action items assigned in INC-4271.

anya: Closing the loop here — will add flamegraphs + pprof captures to the ticket. Thanks everyone :tada:
